usage: telegram-tools [-h]
                      {discover,clear-messages,search,bots,send,create,delete,doctor} ...

positional arguments:
  {discover,clear-messages,search,bots,send,create,delete,doctor}
    discover            List dialogs and forum topics
    clear-messages      Clear messages from forum topic(s), preserving topics
                        and topic IDs
    search              Search and export messages
    bots                List the bots you own and edit their BotFather
                        settings
    send                Send a message to a chat or forum topic
    create              Create a group, channel, or forum topic
    delete              Delete a group, channel, or forum topic (dry-run by
                        default)
    doctor              Check local setup without printing secrets

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
